notes:
Fixes for the DS reports on 2.34.1.

The DS touch screen works during gameplay now. Taps press and release like a real
stylus, so bottom screen menus respond the moment you touch them; before, a tap
either hovered or stuck and menus never fired.

Pausing a DS game shows the SCCM menu again, on top, with your controller driving
it. Before, you could be left looking at DraStic's own menu with a dead
controller. Pause and resume now also verify they landed and retry, so a dropped
key can no longer strand the session between states.

Holding Home force quits DS games, like every other system.

Also: the desktop mouse arrow no longer sits over the picture during play,
Fast-forward moved from the Performance submenu into Game, DS games gained an
Internal resolution setting with Native as the default, and Swap A and B now
appears only on the Gen1 ports.
